hours.note: Last appointments are scheduled at 6:15 PM

services.name: Botox (Anti-Wrinkle Injections)
services.description: Botox injections relax the muscles that cause wrinkles, resulting in a smoother, more refreshed appearance.
services.results_onset: 3–7 days to see initial results, full results at 2 weeks
services.aftercare: Avoid lying down for 4 hours post-treatment and avoid strenuous exercise for 24 hours.

services.name: Dermal Fillers
services.description: Dermal fillers restore lost volume, smooth lines, and contour features using hyaluronic acid gel.
services.results_onset: Immediate, with full results after any swelling subsides (5–7 days)
services.results_duration: 6–18 months depending on the area treated
services.aftercare: Avoid touching the area for 6 hours, avoid extreme temperatures and alcohol for 24 hours.

services.name: Initial Consultation
services.description: A free 30-minute one-on-one session with our aesthetic practitioner. Includes a full facial assessment and personalised treatment recommendation.
services.required_for: All new patients must have a consultation before undergoing any treatment.
services.note: Consultations can be booked via WhatsApp or our website.

booking.cancellation_policy: 24-hour advance notice is required for all cancellations. Late cancellations may incur a rebooking fee.
booking.rescheduling: Please get in touch at least 24 hours before your appointment to reschedule.
booking.deposit: No deposit is required for consultations. Deposits for treatments will be discussed at the time of booking.
booking.new_patient_note: All new patients must complete a health questionnaire before their first appointment.

faqs.question: Are consultations free?
faqs.answer: Yes, your initial consultation is completely free of charge and lasts approximately 30 minutes.

faqs.question: How long does Botox last?
faqs.answer: Botox results typically last 3–4 months. Results may vary depending on the individual and area treated.

faqs.question: How long do fillers last?
faqs.answer: Dermal fillers generally last 6–18 months, depending on the treatment area and product used.

faqs.question: Is there a cancellation fee?
faqs.answer: We require at least 24 hours' notice for cancellations. Late cancellations may incur a rebooking fee.

faqs.question: How do I book?
faqs.answer: You can book via WhatsApp or through our website. Consultations are free and a great first step for new patients.

faqs.question: What are your opening hours?
faqs.answer: We're open Monday to Saturday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM. We're closed on Sundays and UK Bank Holidays.
